subject.title: fix(sessions): preserve active turns during session compaction

question: Should `sessions.compact` refuse with `INVALID_REQUEST` whenever another active turn owns the session, rather than queueing or interrupting that turn?
rationale: The patch fixes an established safety bug, but selecting a refusal as the public manual-compaction behavior affects callers and operator workflows beyond a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve active-work refusal
options.body: Keep the explicit refusal so manual compaction never mutates or terminates a live turn; callers retry after the active turn completes.

options.title: Design deferred compaction
options.body: Replace refusal with a documented queue-or-defer policy if maintainers require a compact request to complete without manual retry.

recommendation.title: Approve active-work refusal
recommendation.body: Keep the explicit refusal so manual compaction never mutates or terminates a live turn; callers retry after the active turn completes.

likelyOwner.reason: The author supplied the active-turn reproduction and implemented the lifecycle boundary, making them the best available contact to clarify the intended behavior.
